general.uiLanguageHint: Interface language. Applied immediately; native menu bars update in a moment.
general.aiLanguageHint: Language AI uses for its replies — commit messages, PR descriptions and explanations. Prompts are not translated.
general.autoRefreshHint: Refreshes commits, branches and panels, and fetches from the remote. Never pulls or pushes.
general.autoUpdateCheckbox: Automatically check for updates on startup
general.updatesHint: Checks GitHub Releases for a newer version. Nothing is downloaded without your confirmation.

appearance.uiFontHint: Interface text. Leads the platform fallback chain; CJK fallbacks stay active.
appearance.monoFontHint: Diff, blame, graph, commit message and other code surfaces.

network.modeSystemHint: Uses the proxy configured in the OS network settings. Linux follows proxy environment variables.
network.modeManualHint: All network access — AI, fetch/push/clone, LFS, update checks — uses the address below.
network.modeOffHint: No proxy is applied. Proxy variables from the launch environment keep working.
network.loopbackHint: The proxy GitWave applies always skips local addresses (localhost / 127.0.0.1).
